recentItems.title: Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford's Son, Dead at 27 | E! News
recentItems.description:
Presley Gerber, the son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, died in a rehab facility on Sept. 20, according to the Los Angeles Medical Examiner. Presley, brother of Kaia Gerber, was 27. The model made his runway debut at Jeremy Scott’s 2016 Moschino Resort show and later spoke openly about his mental health journey, hoping his candor would help others feel less alone. His cause of death had not been determined, while a family representative told TMZ the family is asking for privacy during the “very difficult and painful time.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/videos/2514793539781/cindy-crawfords-son-presley-gerber-dead-at-27

recentItems.title: See Meg Ryan, Son Jack Quaid Make Rare Lucas Museum Appearance | E! News
recentItems.description:
Meg Ryan and her son Jack Quaid made their first mother-son public appearance in over eight years while attending the opening of the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles Sept. 19. The 64-year-old actress and 34-year-old The Boys star posed together on the red carpet, with Ryan wearing a black jacquard midi dress with ruffled trim and Quaid sporting a dark gray suit and his wedding band after marrying Claudia Doumit in April. The pair last appeared together at a New York Knicks game in December 2017 and previously worked together on 2015’s Ithaca, which Ryan directed and Quaid starred in. recentItems.title: Connie Britton, Ruby Rose & More Stars Attend Hayden Panettiere’s Memorial | E! News
recentItems.description:
Connie Britton, Ruby Rose and Evan Ross were among those who attended Hayden Panettiere’s memorial in Malibu one month after her death. The Sept. 19 celebration of life also brought together Panettiere’s former Nashville costars Charles Esten, Sam Palladio and Jonathan Jackson, with roughly 150 guests reportedly in attendance. Panettiere died Aug. 16 at age 36, and her cause and manner of death remain pending as the investigation continues.
